comments.body:
## Audit Complete ✅

**10-agent swarm + 5-chair council review completed.** Final report at `Data/Pages/Audits/codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md`.

**Key results:**
- 106 raw findings → 79 post-council (5 P0, 14 P1, 28 P2, 32 P3)
- 2 false positives removed, 17 findings merged into 7 groups
- 15 severity recalibrations, 6 new architectural findings
- 3 security escalations to P0 (sendEvent crash, crash guard handlers, pipe buffer hang)
- 2 security gaps identified by council (LLM prompt injection P0, rate limiting P1)

**New tasks created (14 total):**
- TSK-0373: Fix /api/about hardcoded version
- TSK-0374: Error handling in memory gateways
- TSK-0375: Remove stale Python scripts
- TSK-0376: WebSocketBridge unit tests
- TSK-0377: Backfill null timestamps
- TSK-0378: _isComplete regression test
- TSK-0379: e2e integration test
- TSK-0380: sendEvent crash guard (Critical)
- TSK-0381: Crash guard handlers (Critical)
- TSK-0382: Pipe buffer hang (Critical)
- TSK-0383: LLM prompt injection (Critical)
- TSK-0384: BuildGoal.Id property
- TSK-0385: Entity prompt duplication fix
- TSK-0386: Rate limiting/cmdQueue cap

**Roadmap updated:** Sprint 60 Wave C → Complete, Wave F (Post-Wave-C Audit Fixes) added with 14 tasks. Sprint 61 restructured with audit remediation waves.

**Key cross-cutting themes:**
1. Node.js crash surface unprotected (3 independent P0s)
2. ITimeProvider adoption stalled (3+ components)
3. Goal HasFailed architecturally dead (5/7 goals)
4. Dashboard dual-write corruption
5. Runtime decomposition aspirational (Sprint 36+, never integrated)
6. LLM prompt injection unaddressed
